title: Cantilever sensor arm (mechanical, load-bearing)
goal: An aluminum cantilever arm that holds a 0.5 kg sensor 150 mm out from a wall mount. It must not yield under 3x the static sensor load with a safety factor >= 2.5, and stay under 120 g. Author and commit the arm geometry, then validate it with FEA against the safety-factor requirement.

requirements: tip load quantified (0.5 kg x 3x static)
design: cantilever arm geometry authored and committed as a viewable cad_model
cross-section + material (aluminum) chosen with rationale tied to bending stress
simulation: FEA run on the arm under the tip load
pass-fail verdict recorded against the SF>=2.5 requirement
